prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, copy] Adoption Certificate Account Protection Copy: Updates the headline and text on the adoption certificate screen to reassure users that their pet and progress are automatically saved to their account.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "body": "Your pet choices and progress are automatically saved to your account so you never lose your companion."}}
1: [finish, redesign] Desktop Controls Quick Reference Card: Redesigns the home_intro screen into a centered layout with clear instructions on how to reveal, hide, and interact with the pet once on the desktop.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Right-click your pet to open controls, drag to move across your screen, or click to chat anytime.", "button_label": "Summon Pet to Desktop"}}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Pre-Adoption Companion Selection Flow: Adds a dedicated companion preview screen right before choosing friend styles in the adoption flow.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "new_companion_preview", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "pick_friend": {"headline": "Choose Your Companion Base Archetype", "body": "Select the initial starter style for your new pet companion."}}
3: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In After Photo Upload: Moves sign-in to take place immediately after photo upload, letting users customize their pet before creating or logging into an account.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "sign_in", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [sign_in, copy] Instant Account Recovery Copy on Sign-In: Updates the sign-in headline and body copy to emphasize that existing pets and progress will be instantly restored upon signing in.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Preserve & Restore Your Pet", "body": "Log in to safely back up your active companion or restore your existing pets instantly."}}
5: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Pet Launch Confirmation Screen: Inserts a dedicated launch confirmation screen before home_intro that verifies desktop display readiness.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_pet_launch_confirm", "home_intro"], "home_intro": {"button_label": "Launch Pet to Desktop"}}
6: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Guidelines Assistance: Adds explicit photo upload hint text detailing lighting and focus tips for optimal custom pet generation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"headline": "Upload Pet Photo", "body": "Upload a clear image of your pet to generate your unique custom companion.", "hint": "Use a clear, well-lit photo showing your pet facing forward for best rendering accuracy."}}
7: [choose_path, redesign] Story-To-Path Direct Transition Redesign: Redesigns the choose_path screen into a stage layout that directly continues the story intro.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Embark on Your Companion Journey", "body": "Select how you would like to start creating your companion experience today."}}
8: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Pet Generation Safety Info: Enables progress indicator and reassuring body text on the waiting screen during pet rendering.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Bringing Your Companion to Life", "body": "Your pet is being crafted. Please keep this window open while generation completes.", "show_progress": true}}
9: [sign_in, layout] Sign-In Provider Reassurance Banner: Switches sign-in screen to a split layout highlighting safe cloud saving alongside authentication choices.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Secure Your Companion Account", "body": "Sign in to securely link your pet companion data and maintain persistence across restarts."}}

verdicts.reason: Copy update keeps the adoption certificate functionality intact without violating pricing or fair design rules.
Redesigning home_intro layout and controls reference stays within allowed onboarding modifications.
Adding a new pre-adoption preview screen into onboarding is permitted and retains all required steps.
Reordering sign-in to take place after photo upload is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.
Copy update on the sign-in screen maintains its core function without introducing dark patterns or pricing text.
Adding a new launch confirmation screen before home_intro is allowed inside onboarding.
Adding photo upload guidelines assistance enhances clarity without breaking any onboarding rules.
Redesigning the choose_path layout and copy maintains the step's core purpose while staying within onboarding limits.
Enabling progress indicator and safety text on the waiting screen preserves its function and adheres to fair design.
Updating sign-in to a split layout with cloud saving reassurance maintains authentication job and onboarding compliance.
